name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds the draggable first-row media bar with configurable timing and image type; split solid and gradient Abyss controls; Home logo placement; automatic section refresh; Continue Watching and Next Up removal; My List using Jellyfin Likes; series information; selected-library infinite scroll; collections on detail pages; enhanced Jellyfin-only search; header breadcrumbs; manual ordering; and full section art appearance settings. Uses a named JavaScript Injector loader while preserving existing Injector scripts. Requires Abyss, Collection Manager, and JavaScript Injector; File Transformation 2.5.11.0 is recommended for Jellyfin 10.11.11.
